thread:
frank: FYI planning a small EU canary Fri 09:00 UTC. Need a 1-2 sentence internal RN + quick ops checklist. Model pin: v7.0.1-int8, fallback v7.0.0. Can someone grab the blurb? @priya @oliver
priya: I can. Keep it tight (<40 words). What are the hard gates and owner?
oliver: Gates: p95 <=120ms, errors <0.4%. Hard rollback if errors >0.8% for 3m OR eval drift >2% on the smoke set. Owner for first hour?
oncall-zoe: I'll take 09:00-11:00 UTC. Will run smoke at T+5/T+20 and watch p95/errors.
deploy-bot: queued job db-44123 by @frank. Command to execute:
```
/deploy canary --model v7.0.1-int8 --region eu --window 30m --notify #eng-oncall
```
ops-bot: preflight check: smoke scripts present, alerting hooks ok, dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-canary-v7. Rate limiter and quota validated.
priya: Draft blurb:
"INTERNAL: EU canary v7.0.1-int8  Fri 09:00 UTC. Owner: @oncall-zoe. Fallback: v7.0.0. Targets: p95 <=120ms, errors <0.4%. Embargo until 10:15 UTC. Breach -> immediate pin & rollback. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-canary-v7"
oliver: tiny edits: add note that deploy-bot will auto-pause if p95 >180ms and that rollback path is immediate pin to v7.0.0.
priya: updated. approvals?
frank: +1
oncall-zoe: +1 :thumbsup: I'll run the smoke scripts and file incident stub if we hit hard rollback.
frank: I'll paste final RN into #internal-announce 10m prior and pin in #eng-releases. deploy-bot, set job db-44123 to ready.
deploy-bot: job db-44123 -> ready. Will emit start/finish events and pause on thresholds. :robot_face:
ops-bot: If rollback occurs, follow runbook: https://runbook.company/redwood/rollback-quick and tag #incidents. Closing thread  thanks all.
